verdict.rationale: Setting up a developer toolchain is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented single command that installs packages, tools, and runtimes. Migration Assistant moves files and settings from an old machine, and the built-in CLI utilities (pbcopy, qlmanage, hidutil) are individual preinstalled tools, so both are adjacent features rather than one-command environment provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full set of packages, tools, and runtimes ready to use with a single command
